newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 7.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:
* Two days of fighting in Cambodia ended with one of the country's two prime ministers, the former Communist Hun Sen, declaring victory.
* Mexican officials said "there are indications" that a man who died in Mexico City after facial surgery and liposuction was Amado Carrillo Fuentes, the billionaire drug trafficker.
* The first mobile explorer of another planed started prospecting the soil and rocks of Mars.
* Gowth in the economy of Long Island, N.Y., has come in unexpected ways that owe little to the rules of the past.
* President Clinton took a personal interest in the hiring of John Huang by the Democratic National Committee.
* A government-appointed commission in Barbados is considering whether to discard Queen Elizabeth II as head of state and declare Barbados a republic.
